allow: PowerShell($basePath = "$env:APPDATA\\npm-cache\\_npx"; Get-ChildItem $basePath | ForEach-Object { $hash = $_.Name; $modPath = Join-Path $basePath "$hash\\node_modules"; $pkgs = Get-ChildItem $modPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($pkgs\) { Write-Host "$hash -> $\($pkgs.Name -join ', '\)" } })

PowerShell($basePath = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\npm-cache\\_npx"; Get-ChildItem $basePath | ForEach-Object { $hash = $_.Name; $modPath = Join-Path $basePath "$hash\\node_modules"; $pkgs = Get-ChildItem $modPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($pkgs\) { Write-Host "$hash -> $\($pkgs.Name -join ', '\)" } })
